hardware.clock_basis: Same-window raw GPC series means are about 1.35e9-1.38e9 for Prefill and 1.65e9-1.73e9 for Decode. Treating these as Hz gives the rounded worker-wide scenario ranges above. Nsight labels them MHz; device mapping and per-kernel frequency are not established. These are explicit scenarios, not measured per-kernel ceilings. Never normalize 1979 TFLOPS by the CUDA-core maximum 1980 MHz.

followup_contract: Every candidate names the kernel, exact shape/precision/source hash, work removed (FLOPs/bytes/instructions), and predicted resource limit before GPU dispatch.
Keep theory, conditional scenario, measured microbenchmark and measured normal serving results distinct. Unknown is null, never zero.
Do not sum per-kernel opportunities across overlapped phases, count FC1/FC2 twice under the fused MegaMoE, or translate logical bytes directly into measured HBM bandwidth.
Update previous_trials and source/profile identity after a run. No repeat of failed candidates without an explicitly changed failure mechanism.
Use existing archived data first. A new measurement must resolve a named uncertainty that can change the decision. No job is dispatched by these scripts.
Normal serving completion time, goodput, ITL and acceptance are the final check. TTFT movement alone does not prove less work.
